description: Use this when comparing cash, a loan, and adding a battery later with numbers the caller already has. Do not use this to offer a rate or say they should borrow. A missing rate uses a labelled 7% teaching default, not a lender rate.

annual_battery_extra_savings_aud.description: Extra annual energy saving attributed to the battery, on top of the solar-only figure.

annual_solar_savings_aud.description: Annual energy saving for solar only, if the caller already has an illustrative figure. Omit to skip payback.

battery_cost_aud.description: Extra upfront price for a battery in AUD. Omit or use 0 if there is no battery in the comparison.

illustrative_annual_rate_percent.description: Hypothetical interest rate in percent per year, for arithmetic only. Not a rate SparkReady offers. Omit to use 7, labelled as a teaching default.

loan_term_years.description: Loan term in whole years, for the illustration.

solar_cost_aud.description: Upfront solar price in AUD, taken from a quote the caller already has. Not a SparkReady price.

name: compare_scenarios
title: Compare cash, loan, and staging
